verdict.rationale: Opting out of AI training is a fair question for an AI design and app-generation product, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence pack covers AI training data use, opt-out controls, or data-privacy settings. Doc 6's mention of securely storing data in an app backend is a different feature and earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
